title: Seasonal LED Pattern Gallery
description: Four strips running the same algorithm, and the two or three numbers that make each one a different season.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Raspberry Pi Pico, MicroPython, and the Moving Rainbow Kit

educational.audience: Mentors choosing a pattern for a session

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a running LED pattern, the learner differentiates which seasonal theme produced it and identifies the code parameter that changed to create it.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Watch all four at once, click one to see its parameters, and change the shared speed
pedagogical.assessment: Show a running strip and ask which theme it is and which parameter says so.
